# Jiro

> Jiro is a background coding agent by Nori. It runs Claude Code or Codex in isolated cloud VMs on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription or API key, or Cursor with a Cursor API key, works from Slack and the web, and opens pull requests on your GitHub repos for review.

## Alternatives

- [Amp alternatives (2026): coding agents compared after the orbs relaunch](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/amp.md): Amp (ampcode.com) alternatives compared: Jiro, Claude Code on the web, Cursor cloud agents, Codex cloud, Tembo and OpenHands. Sources and dates for every claim.
- [Claude Code on the web alternatives (2026): cloud Claude Code for teams](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/claude-code-web.md): Alternatives to Claude Code on the web for teams: Jiro, Codex cloud, Cursor cloud agents, Amp, Tembo and Copilot cloud agent, compared with sources.
- [OpenAI Codex cloud alternatives (2026)](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/codex-cloud.md): Codex cloud alternatives compared: Jiro, Claude Code on the web, Cursor cloud agents, Copilot cloud agent, Jules and Devin. Sourced, dated, fair.
- [GitHub Copilot coding agent alternatives (2026)](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/copilot-coding-agent.md): Alternatives to GitHub Copilot coding agent (now Copilot cloud agent): Jiro, Codex cloud, Cursor cloud agents, Claude Code on the web, Devin and OpenHands.
- [Cursor background agents alternatives (2026): now called Cloud Agents](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/cursor-background-agents.md): Alternatives to Cursor's background agents (renamed Cloud Agents): Jiro, Codex cloud, Copilot cloud agent, Claude Code on the web, Devin and Amp, compared with sources.
- [Devin alternatives (2026): background coding agents compared](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/devin.md): The best Devin alternatives in 2026, compared on where they run, which models you can bring, where you start work, and what they cost. Sourced and dated.
- [Factory alternatives (2026): Droids vs other background coding agents](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/factory.md): Factory (Droids) alternatives compared on deployment, model keys, triggers and price: Jiro, Devin, Cursor cloud agents, OpenHands and Copilot cloud agent.
- [Jules alternatives (2026): cloud coding agents beyond Google's](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/jules.md): Google Jules alternatives compared: Jiro, Codex cloud, Cursor cloud agents, Copilot cloud agent, Devin and OpenHands, with sourced limits and prices.
- [Kiro alternatives (2026): other AI coding agents to Amazon's Kiro](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/kiro.md): Alternatives to Amazon's Kiro: Jiro, Cursor cloud agents, Copilot cloud agent, Claude Code on the web, Codex cloud and Devin. Jiro is not Kiro; here is how they differ.
- [Warp alternatives (2026): terminals vs cloud coding agents](https://jiro.bot/alternatives/warp.md): Warp alternatives for both kinds of Warp user: terminal replacements, and alternatives to Warp's cloud agents (Jiro, Cursor cloud agents, Tembo, OpenHands, Copilot cloud agent).

## Get started

- [Start the 30-day free trial](https://login.norisessions.com/?signup=1&entrypoint=jiro)
- Install Jiro's skills into your own agent: `npx nori-skillsets install public/jiro`
